selection_rationale: In customer churn prediction, Recall is critical to minimize False Negatives (failing to identify customers who cancel). Logistic Regression captures 55.88% of churners compared to Random Forest's 42.78%, achieving a superior F1-score (0.6040 vs 0.5237) and highest ROC-AUC (0.8411 vs 0.8397). It is also transparent, computationally lightweight, and produces well-calibrated odds ratios.
